g.text: Predicted mass changes match real biology

g.title: test whether predicted mass changes biologically meaningful authors compare them
g.desc: To test whether the predicted mass changes are biologically meaningful, the authors compare them against independent measurements.
g.text: Are the predicted mass changes biologically meaningful?

g.title: going further predicted weights line spatially proliferation marker ki67 where
g.desc: Going further, the predicted weights line up spatially with a proliferation marker, Ki67, where NubOT predicts weights above one, and with an apoptosis marker where it predicts weights below one, confirming that the model is recovering real proliferation and death signals rather than fitting the distribution superficially.
g.text: SPATIAL MARKER ALIGNMENT · UMAP — weights > 1 ↔ Ki67 proliferation · weights < 1 ↔ apoptosis (FIGURE 4)

g.title: summing nubot predicted weights within subpopulation they find strong correlation
g.desc: Summing NubOT's predicted weights within each subpopulation, they find a strong correlation with the observed change in cell counts after eight hours, with a correlation coefficient of point nine five.

g.title: after twenty-four hours correlation drops point four four because some
g.desc: After twenty-four hours the correlation drops to point four four, because for some drugs the induced cell death is so severe that too few cells remain to evaluate reliably, yet the overall trend still holds.
g.text: populations, yet the trend still holds.
NubOT · Neural Unbalanced Optimal Transport · NeurIPS 2022
